name: Dark Storms
summary: In Durotar, Burning Blade cultists corrupt the land from Thunder Ridge. Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill has learned that the goblin warlock Fizzle Darkstorm leads them, and asks you to end his threat.

sections.title: A Threat in the Ridge
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar has learned that dark magic has taken hold in Thunder Ridge, northwest of Razor Hill. Burning Blade cultists prowl the ravine while young Horde defenders patrol Durotar’s borders. Their presence brings ruin to the wildlife and land.

sections.title: Fizzle Darkstorm
sections.body: Fizzle Darkstorm, a goblin warlock allied with the Burning Blade, directs the cultists in Thunder Ridge. He wields fel power for the cult rather than serving commerce or cartel interests. Slaying him and bringing back his twisted claw will show Orgnil that the cult’s leaders in the ravine have been struck down.

sections.title: Rooting Out the Cult
sections.body: The Burning Blade embodies the demonic servitude, corruption, and bloodthirsty madness Thrall’s new Horde seeks to leave behind. Fizzle’s death removes an active conspirator from Durotar’s interior. The shadow over the orcish homeland reaches beyond isolated encampments.

faq.answer: Fizzle Darkstorm is a goblin warlock working for the Burning Blade cult. He and his followers shelter in Thunder Ridge and spread demonic chaos through the ravine, until Orgnil Soulscar calls for his execution.
Thunder Ridge lies in northwestern Durotar, north of Razor Hill and southwest of Orgrimmar. Lightning-infused beasts and Burning Blade cultists occupy its rugged canyon.

faq.q: Why is the Burning Blade in Durotar?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade seeks to undermine Thrall’s Horde and restore demonic dominance over the orcs. Its members hide in ravines, caves, and canyons across Durotar, sowing corruption from within.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil Soulscar want Fizzle's claw specifically?
faq.answer: Orgnil wants Fizzle’s claw as unmistakable proof that the warlock is dead. It confirms that the head of the Thunder Ridge cultists can no longer direct their operations.

faq.q: What happens after Fizzle is slain?
faq.answer: After Fizzle falls, you bring word to Orgnil Soulscar. He sends you to Margoz, a shaman who knows more about the Burning Blade’s corruption, so you can pursue further conspiracies.

faq.q: Why would a goblin work for the Burning Blade?
aliases: why is fizzle with the cult
faq.answer: Some goblins are drawn to shadow magic for its power, influence, and dark arts. Fizzle embraced fel witchcraft and put his ruthless cunning at the cultists’ service.

angles.text: As an orc, you know the Burning Blade embodies the dark past your people struggle to overcome. Driving out infiltrators like Fizzle helps protect Thrall’s free nation.
As a warlock, you see how Fizzle’s reckless devotion to fel power makes him a danger and an embarrassment to disciplined Horde practitioners.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Durotar’s heart from demonic subversion, so the Horde can turn its defenses outward without collapsing from within.
As a shaman, you know Fizzle’s dark rites and his minions disturb Thunder Ridge’s natural spirits and agitate its beasts. The elemental balance must be restored.
